notes.title: Bitardia – Story Update Trailer
notes.content:
I didn’t update the game for a long time, and didn’t add new story missions even longer. I present a new update that adds not only a new chapter to the storyline, but also a number of improvements throughout the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10543512/497b27bae5f6adfb2483235e75accbbce91f1dba.png[/img]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OQBdMA3YMaA
Buy with 60% discount (until November 27): http://store.steampowered.com/app/405010

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Since the last update took six months. This time I was engaged in the updating and development Bitardia Cards, which became part of the core. Today represents a new update, added new story missions, the quest "Hotline Bitardia", quest with cards and a lot of small changes.

notes.title: Bugfix #2
notes.content:
Fixed:
- Bug when the quest (such as the final).
- Bug with additions. It was noticeable on a mission with the installation of bombs. Also added was a clue how to put them.
- It is a pointer to the caravan, which can rob.
- Fixed an issue with spawn the following story missions on the map after the completion of the previous ones.
- And other minor bug fixes.
